text: yep good. now this shit keeps happening on hot updates. code hits -> ui reloads -> mesh randomly has a few near by recently touched faces turned to glass and i have to remove the glass from it to restore its normal state
resolution: Fixed the hot-update glass corruption at its load/resume boundary. A remounted React surface was replaying the stale RJMD trailing-glass boundary onto a newer host-resident mesh whose topology and face order already survived the reload, turning recently touched tail faces translucent. Cold loads still restore saved glass once; hot-resumed sessions now preserve live per-face alpha untouched. Added a red-then-green regression, passed the existing paint-hydration suite and editor type-check, and completed the ReleaseFast editor build.
